about_the_game:
PATRON DLC: Support The Game and Unlock Exclusive Content

The PATRON DLC is a special thank-you option for Players who want to support the development of The Chess. While the base game is completely free to play, this DLC is a small, symbolic purchase - "" - that allows you to show your appreciation.

Key Features:

♔ Support the Developers – Your purchase helps improve and expand the game with future updates and new features.

♕ Exclusive Patron Badge

♖ No Restrictions – Enjoy the full game without limitations, and support The Chess at your own pace.

♗ Symbolic Price – A small gesture to say "Thank You" for creating this chess experience for Players of all skills and age.

This DLC is purely optional. You can continue to enjoy The Chess for free, but if you want to show your support and gain some exclusive content, PATRON DLC is the perfect way to do so!

CALL TO ACTION: ⭐ Show your support and unlock unique content with the PATRON DLC today! 👍 Follow the game for news, updates, and future DLCs! 💬 Leave a Review and let us know what you'd like to see next!
